bugs.title: Every public website page crashes to 'Something went wrong' (ErrorBoundary)
bugs.root_cause: The arrow function implicitly returns the value of window.scrollTo(). In current Chromium (UA Chrome/156) scrollTo returns a Promise (verified in page: String(window.scrollTo(0,0)) === '[object Promise]'). React then treats that Promise as the effect cleanup and throws 'TypeError: destroy is not a function'. Same pattern at line 25 (`() => setOpen(false)`) is harmless but should also use braces. Fix: `useEffect(() => { window.scrollTo(0, 0); }, [pathname]);`
bugs.evidence: Screenshot site-pages-catalog-seo-404-failure.png shows the 'Something went wrong / RELOAD' boundary on /, /news and /support. Console: 'useEffect must not return anything besides a function... TypeError: destroy is not a function'. The backend is healthy: GET /api/v1/public/catalog 200 {characters:6,boards:6,worlds:6,powerups:5}; /public/news 200 empty_message 'No news yet — check back soon'; /public/site-config store_url_android null; /sitemap.xml 200. The admin realm (not under SiteLayout) renders fine.

action_items.detail: Each TOTP code works only once, so test helpers wait for a fresh 30s window (/tmp/rr_totp_used.json). The ingress rate-limits admin login (429) when browser checks run back to back, so wait about 60-90s between admin browser runs.
The admin session cookie is Secure, so over plain http://localhost the tests set the Cookie header by hand. This is expected and not a bug.
POST /admin/purchases/{id}/reverify on a mock purchase returns 200 (mock adapter). Per spec_deviations, real tokens would return verification_unavailable.

Cleanup verified: /api/v1/config maintenance=false. /public/news has no items. Config is now v22 after the rollbacks, with the same values as before the tests (zoe 25000 coins). Throwaway admins tscheck-auth-*/tscheck-lock-* (viewer role) remain. The lock admin is locked.
